tasks.span: to keep track of their tasks

tasks.purpose: to keep links to all relevant documents, to-do lists, decisions, etc. all in one place where all involved parties could view and keep track of progress
tasks.span: to coordinate wedding planning for my wedding across myself, my spouse, and our respective parents

benefits.claim: It is the absolute best task management / to-do list tracker software.
benefits.span: Trello is the absolute best task management / to-do list tracker software.

benefits.claim: It shines for group collaboration with features like shared boards, task assignment, and user tagging.
benefits.span: where it truly shines is for group collaboration with the ability to all view the same board, assign tasks to different users, tag users in comments, etc.

benefits.claim: The free version is entirely worthwhile to use.
benefits.span: I still find the free version entirely worthwhile to use

frictions.claim: Many useful tools and views (like calendar and timeline) are not available in the free version.
frictions.span: many of the useful tools and views (calendar view, timeline view) are not available in the free version
